title: Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Episode 6 Preview Revealed
content: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed the Episode 6 preview images and synopsis ahead of its August 9 premiere. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as part of its Summer 2026 lineup .
author: Anime Corner

title: Kaiju No. 8: Narumi's Week Anime Trailer Revealed, 4 Episodes Starting on September 5
content: Kaiju No. 8 has revealed new details for its previously announced original short anime Narumi’s Week at Work , confirming a September 5 premiere along with the first trailer. The four-episode series will stream weekly every Saturday on the TOHO animation YouTube channel and other platforms.
author: Anime Corner

title: New SYNXRO Project Aims to Turn Original Anime Openings Into Full Multimedia IPs
content: A new multimedia initiative called SYNXRO Project has launched with an unusual concept: creating original “fake anime openings” that can eventually grow into full anime, manga, or novel franchises.
author: Anime Corner

title: Chainsmoker Cat Anime Casts Yū Kobayashi
content: The staff of the television anime of Nyan Nyan Factory 's Chainsmoker Cat ( Yanineko ) manga announced on Wednesday that Yū Kobayashi is joining the anime's cast as Penpen Neko. The character will appear in the anime's sixth episode on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: Josemaru Short Anime's 2nd Teaser Unveils Lead Cast Member, More Staff
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for the television short anime of creator Inochi-ya's Josemaru character revealed the anime's second teaser promotional video and teaser visual, lead cast member, and additional staff members on Wednesday. Riho Tsuda voices the title character Josemaru .
author: ANN

title: Shōzen TV Anime's 1st Promo Video Reveals April 2027 Debut
content: The staff for Shōzen , the television anime adaptation of Jiang Jia Meizi 's Chinese manhua Shang Shan , revealed on Wednesday the anime's first promotional video and April 2027 premiere.
author: ANN

title: Chinese Fantasy Manhua Shozen Reveals First Anime Trailer, April 2027 Release Date
content: The upcoming anime adaptation of Shozen has released its first full trailer, confirming an April 2027 release date. The series is based on Jiang Jia Meizi’s fantasy manhua, which is serialized on Bilibili Manga.
author: Anime Corner

title: Koma-Dori Mofmof Parade Stop-Motion Anime Unveils Cast, Staff, January 2027 Debut
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks revealed on Wednesday the main cast and staff members, and January 2027 debut of Koma-Dori Mofmof Parade (Stop-Motion Mofmof Parade or KomaMof for short), the stop-motion anime of the IDOLiSH7 franchise 's Mofmof mini characters' Mofmof Parade (or MofPara for short) project.
author: ANN

title: Twin Engine, Bandai Partner for Manga, Animation, Merchandise Plans
content: Anime planning and production company Twin Engine (production for Vinland Saga , Dororo , Hell's Paradise: Jigokuraku ) announced on Wednesday that it has entered into a strategic partnership with toy and merchandising company Bandai Co., Ltd. with the two companies planning to produce at least one new joint project.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action My Sister's Boyfriend Film's Teaser Announces More Cast
content: The official website for My Sister's Boyfriend, the live-action film of Amu Meguro 's Midori Loves My Sister ( Onē-chan no Midori-kun or literally My Sister's Midori-kun) manga, presented a new teaser trailer and poster visual for the film on Wednesday. The teaser announces more cast members for the film.
author: ANN
